temp_employment_matlab_model_project.title: Research project: MATLAB model of temporary employment, firm heterogeneity and regulation (working code as of Nov 2023)
temp_employment_matlab_model_project.content: The user is developing a MATLAB labor-economics model of temporary employment, firm heterogeneity and regulation (the working program is headed 'Temporary Employment, Firm Heterogeneity and Regulation'; discussed 2023-11-08). Model structure from the user's own code: heterogeneous firm productivity y; permanent-job cutoff lambdap computed analytically as (y - r*U - r*cc)/(cc + fc); temporary-job cutoff lambdat solved numerically with csolve on eval_lambdat(lambda, cc, U, fc, r, y); the full program also solves a conversion cutoff lambdas with fzero. Stocks: stockP is the integral of (1/lambda) weighted by G(lambdap, dscale, dshape) - G(1e-8, dscale, dshape) over [1e-8, lambdap]; stockT is the integral of (1/lambda)*log(y/(r*U)) weighted by G(lambdat, dscale, dshape) - G(lambdap, dscale, dshape) over [lambdap, lambdat]. Parameters: dscale and dshape (parameters of the shock-arrival-rate distribution G), fc and cc (labeled in the code as firing costs and cost of writing a contract), r (interest rate, converted from annual to daily), U (unemployment value normalized to 1/r).

temp_employment_gmm_estimation_plan_2023.title: Temporary employment model: estimating dscale, dshape, fc, cc by GMM from observed y, stockP, stockT data instead of pre-decided values (decided 2023-11-08)
